why: pr:owner/repo#123 is drawn as a pull request and is pressable before anything is fetched, because the URL is knowable from the text
your own pull requests cannot be guessed from the text, so with no account this says so rather than drawing an empty list
a repository's open pull requests cannot be invented either: a list that is silently empty looks like a repository with no work in it
a word after the repository searches the whole repository rather than filtering the newest thirty, so a match older than that window is still reachable
